description: This PHP source file defines the CellFont class, which provides static methods for manipulating font style attributes such as escapement (superscript/subscript) and underline styles within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling Excel files in XLS format.

classes.name: CellFont
classes.description: A class containing static methods to modify font properties like escapement and underline styles for cells in a spreadsheet.

methods.name: escapement
methods.description: Modifies the font object to set superscript or subscript styles based on an integer code.

methods.name: underline
methods.description: Sets the underline style of a font object based on a predefined mapping.
